# Gavit E-Services

> India-based IT services company in Vadodara, Gujarat — web development, custom software, ERP, AI/LLM integration, remote staffing, and virtual assistant services for clients in India, USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

Founded by Pavan Gavit, Co-founder & CTO (B.E. Information Technology, Parul University, Vadodara).

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.gaviteservice.com/web-development): React, Next.js, Node.js, WordPress, Flutter websites and web apps
- [Custom Software](https://www.gaviteservice.com/custom-software): Bespoke software for SMBs and enterprises
- [IT Staffing & Remote Staffing](https://www.gaviteservice.com/services/it-staff-augmentation): Dedicated developers and managed pods, 10–15 day onboarding
- [ERP Development](https://www.gaviteservice.com/erp-development): Custom ERP for manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and trading
- [AI Software](https://www.gaviteservice.com/ai-software): LLM integration, AI automation, custom AI products
- [GST Billing Software](https://www.gaviteservice.com/gst-billing-software): GST-compliant billing for Indian businesses
- [Virtual Assistant](https://www.gaviteservice.com/virtual-assistant): Admin, research, customer support, and back-office VA teams
- [IT Services & Consultancy](https://www.gaviteservice.com/it-services): IT consulting, cloud, microservices, managed support
- [App Development](https://www.gaviteservice.com/services/web-development): iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter
- [Pricing](https://www.gaviteservice.com/pricing): Transparent plans for GST billing, VA, ERP, and dev teams

## Ideal clients

- US/UK startups needing affordable Indian developers
- SMBs in Gujarat needing custom software or ERP
- Companies needing dedicated remote teams (staff augmentation)
- Businesses needing GST billing or virtual assistant support
